name: bluvana-shopify
description: Bluvana Shopify themes, product automation, brand assets, and commerce research.

scripts.theme:check: shopify theme check --path ./bluvana-shopify-theme && shopify theme check --path ./bluvana-silk-theme
scripts.theme:dev:home: cd bluvana-shopify-theme && shopify theme dev --environment bluvana
scripts.theme:dev:silk: cd bluvana-silk-theme && shopify theme dev --environment bluvana
